data.narrative:
Anello Photonics is a Series B-2 stage company in the Defense & Security sector that has raised $25M to date. The relevant comp universe consists of 2 public peers (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private peers operating in the same sector, including Anduril Industries, Helsing, Castelion, Shield AI, and Saronic.

The peer-median method is not applicable here. While 26 same-sector peers exist in Defense & Security, insufficient overlap exists at Anello's specific stage and valuation tier—zero companies met the filtering criteria of same-stage or adjacent-stage positioning with comparable valuation scale. Applying an all-sector median would lack precision and introduce material bias given the heterogeneity of Defense & Security business models and maturity levels.

Without sufficient narrow-band comparable data or completed triangulation across multiple valuation methods, no specific range can be supported by this analysis. The primary constraint is the thinly populated intersection of stage, sector, and scale. A more robust valuation would require either expanding the methodology to include revenue or growth-based multiples (where Anello's financial metrics are available), discounted cash flow analysis if long-term projections are defined, or closer examination of the identified private peer set—particularly the five named peers—to determine whether any exhibit sufficiently similar profiles to warrant detailed comparison. Key uncertainties remain around Anello's revenue trajectory, margins, and technical differentiation relative to the broader Defense & Security ecosystem.
